author: TexLite contributors
description: Three-panel overview of CLIP redrawn after Figure 1 of Radford et al., ICML 2021: contrastive pre-training with the N by N similarity matrix, a dataset classifier built from label text, and zero-shot prediction. The original photographs are replaced by neutral placeholders.

invariants: positions are in layout units traced from the original figure; move boxes and wires together so that wires still meet their boxes
matched pairs stay on the diagonal of the matrix
the third score cell stays highlighted and points to the predicted class unless the example changes
preserve the train-*, m-<i>-<j>, test-*, score-<j>, prompt and answer node names
keep the source note at the top of the file
edit_contract.node_naming: panel 1: (train-text) (train-t<j>) (train-i<i>) and matrix cells (m-<i>-<j>) with row 4 and column 4 as the ellipses; panels 2 and 3: (prompt) (test-t<j>) (test-i1) (score-<j>) (answer)

operations.summary: edit the label macros at the top
replace a \photo call with \node[inner sep=0pt, anchor=north west] at (x0,y0) {\includegraphics[width=...]{...}};
rename the encoders and symbols, e.g. audio and text
delete the scope after the first panel to get only the contrastive training figure

parameters.meaning: size of one layout unit; scales the geometry while the type size stays fixed
parameters.name: \gridunit

parameters.meaning: embedding symbols and the last index
parameters.name: \rowsym, \colsym, \lastindex

name: CLIP method overview (Radford et al.)

source.paper: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
